title: AI for Productivity in the Age of Agentic AI

fields.title: AI for Productivity in the Age of Agentic AI
fields.authors: Xi, Z., Zhou, E., Fang, X., ..., Ying, K., ..., Huang, X.
fields.description: The article distinguishes two ways agentic AI can affect productivity: reducing effort for existing tasks and making previously infeasible work economically viable. It reviews stages of AI system development, adoption across sectors and challenges in reliability, governance and labor markets.
